paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between average lagging (AL) and BLEU scores across four different conditions. The x-axis represents "Average Lagging (AL)" on a linear scale, with values ranging from 2.5 to 10.0, marked with regular intervals of 2.5 units. The y-axis indicates "BLEU" scores, also on a linear scale, covering a range from 25 to 32 with increments of 1 unit. The plot includes four lines: a light purple line with circle markers and a dashed pattern, representing "Consistency-CE," starts near 26 BLEU at 2.5 AL and rises to approximately 31.5 at 10.0 AL; a dark purple line with square markers and a dashed pattern, representing "Inconsistency-CE", follows a similar path from around 26 BLEU at slightly lower than 2.5 AL to about 31.5 at 10.0 AL; a blue line with square markers and a dashed pattern, labeled "Inconsistency-CE-MP," starts at about 27 BLEU at 2.5 AL, progressing to around 32 at 10.0 AL; finally, a red line with star markers and a solid pattern, labeled "Consistency-Bi," begins at roughly 29 BLEU at 3 AL and increases steadily to approximately 32 at 10.0 AL. The purple line intersects the blue line at x value of 4 and it intersects the dark purple line at AL of 6 and all 3 line intersects at around x=9. A legend is available on the bottom right of the plot to infer different lines by their styles.
